title: MiMeDat Microstructure Module
description: Time-ordered array of microstructure snapshots. Each snapshot records the microstructural state of a structured (voxel) grid at one point in a workflow stage, described at the grid, grain and voxel level. Selected simulation-ready (undeformed) snapshots carry a content-derived microstructure_state_id that lets the state be referenced beyond the data object in which it was generated.
$comment: Part of the MiMeDat schema (https://github.com/Ronakshoghi/MiMeDat); referenced from the 'microstructure' property of microstructure_sensitive_mechanical_metadata_schema.json. Obligation levels: M (mandatory) = listed in 'required'; O (optional) = not listed. Units are declared in the 'units' block of the enclosing data object (length, angle, stress, time); volumes are expressed in the cube of the length unit. Grain and voxel records are extensible: additional state or visualization quantities may be added. Licensed under CC BY 4.0. Identifier convention: docs/identifier_convention.md.

snapshot.description: One microstructural state at a single time point of the workflow stage. Snapshots are ordered consecutively by time_point; a recovered (undeformed) snapshot derived from a deformed one shares its time_point and is placed immediately after it.

microstructure_state_id.description: Schema-level identifier of a selected simulation-ready state: the prefix 'S_' followed by the leading eight hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest of the canonical serialization of the state-defining content of the snapshot (see docs/identifier_convention.md). Only snapshots whose grid status is 'undeformed' may carry it; it is assigned when the snapshot is selected for reference or transfer across data objects. A transferred state keeps the same identifier in the data object that reuses it.

time_point.description: Cumulative physical time elapsed from the start of the simulation to the state represented by the snapshot, in the dataset time unit. It increases across all loading steps and cycles and does not reset between them. A recovered snapshot shares the time_point of the deformed snapshot from which it was derived.

grains.description: Constituent-level description of the snapshot (optional). When included, each entry describes one grain; voxel entries must then reference grains through grain_id.

voxels.description: Locally resolved description of the snapshot: one entry per voxel of the grid, carrying the phase, the crystallographic orientation and, where available, field quantities computed by the solver.

allOf.$comment: Identity rule: only undeformed snapshots are eligible for a microstructure_state_id.
Conditional obligation: voxel grain_id is mandatory when the grains array is included and absent otherwise.

grid.description: Spatial frame of the snapshot: how the domain is discretized.

status.description: Deformation configuration of the snapshot. 'undeformed': the voxels form a regular arrangement of cubes, whether the reference configuration that begins a workflow stage or a grid recovered later by regridding. 'deformed': the imposed loading has distorted the grid, so that the voxels are no longer regular cubes and the grid is in general neither regular nor orthogonal.

grid_size.description: Physical size of the domain in x, y, z in the dataset length unit. Exact for an undeformed grid; for a deformed grid a nominal estimate of the current extent obtained by applying the volume-averaged deformation gradient to the reference dimensions.

grid_spacing.description: Voxel spacing in x, y, z in the dataset length unit, interpreted in the same way as grid_size according to the snapshot status.

grain.description: One entry of the grains array. Additional per-grain descriptors may be added.

grain_id.description: Grain identifier, unique within the snapshot and preserved across snapshots wherever the grain persists.

phase_id.description: Identifier of the phase to which the grain belongs; must match a phase_id defined in the job entity of the enclosing data object.

orientation.description: Representative crystal orientation of the grain as Bunge-Euler angles [phi1, Phi, phi2] in the dataset angle unit.

grain_volume.description: Volume of the grain in the cube of the dataset length unit.

parent_grain_id.description: Identifier(s) of the parent grain(s) in the preceding snapshot: an integer for continuity from a single parent, an array when the grain formed from several parents. Included when grain evolution (nucleation, merging, subdivision) is tracked across snapshots and omitted otherwise; unpopulated for the first snapshot of a data object.

voxel.description: One entry of the voxels array. The listed fields are representative; the record may be extended with additional state quantities (e.g. constitutive state variables) or visualization data.

voxel_id.description: Unique voxel identifier within the snapshot.

grain_id.description: Identifier of the grain to which the voxel belongs. Conditional: present when a grain-level description is retained (the grains array is included); absent otherwise.

phase_id.description: Identifier of the phase to which the voxel belongs; a denormalization that links voxels directly to phases so that the phase assignment is available even when the grains array is absent.

centroid_coordinates.description: Voxel centroid position in x, y, z in the dataset length unit, in the reference configuration of the grid on which the snapshot is defined.

voxel_index.description: Integer voxel indices [i, j, k] on the grid (1-based).

voxel_volume.description: Voxel volume in the cube of the dataset length unit.

orientation.description: Crystal orientation of the voxel as Bunge-Euler angles [phi1, Phi, phi2] in the dataset angle unit.

deformation_gradient.description: Deformation gradient F at the voxel (row-major).

first_piola_kirchhoff_stress.description: First Piola-Kirchhoff stress P at the voxel (row-major), in the dataset stress unit.

strain.description: Strain measure at the voxel (row-major); the measure used should be stated in the enclosing data object.

IPFcolor_(1 0 0).description: Visualization data: inverse pole figure colour for the (1 0 0) direction as 8-bit RGB [R, G, B].
